backend_apis.title: Skill Codex Call API
backend_apis.description: Lets an installed skill ask the backend to call Codex for a bounded text response. Multi-item work must be batched into one bounded call that fits the runner timeout. Shell remains prohibited; Codex internet access is allowed only when the skill has runtime network access.

backend_apis.title: Tool UI Schema API
backend_apis.description: Declarative manifest fields for rendering an installed tool in the Tools UI. This is metadata, not app frontend code.
